property.name: previewStage
property.label: Check against stage
property.description: Stage the checklist is measured against. The panel shows what is still missing to reach it, from any current stage.

property.name: autoOpenStages
property.label: Auto-open when moving into
property.description: Semicolon-separated stages that open the window when the record moves into them with fields missing. Leave blank to never auto-open.

property.name: autoOpenFromStages
property.label: Auto-open only when coming from
property.description: Semicolon-separated stages the record must be coming from. Leave blank to open on arrival from any stage.
